name: Medical Grounded Search
title: Medical Grounded Search
author: Isaiah DePorto
description:
### Medical Grounded Search 🩺 (v2.0.0 — Curated Public Medical APIs, Quote Recovery & Gemini Decision 1)

A dedicated, zero-open-web medical retrieval and epistemic verification plugin engineered for **Gemini Chat Hub** (`node:vm` zero-CORS server runtime), **Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite / Gemini 4+**, and **Medical Mode**.

#### Key v2.0.0 Improvements:
1. **Zero Open-Web Noise (Curated Public Medical APIs Only):**
   - **`medical_evidence_search`**: Queries **MedlinePlus Health Topics**, **NCBI PubMed** (multi-subquery splitting, auto-broadening, `NOT Case Reports` guard), **PMC BioC JSON** (`RESULTS`/`CONCL`/`TABLE`), **NIH NCCIH** monographs, **PubChem PUG-View**, **Europe PMC**, and structured **ClinicalTrials.gov v2**. Optional `pubmedQueries`, `trialCondition`, `trialIntervention`, `trialPhase`, and `supplements` params let Gemini 4 steer searches directly and bypass the internal LLM router.
   - **`drug_and_interaction_lookup`**: **RxNav/RxNorm** + **RxClass (`FDASPL`)** normalization, single-ingredient **OpenFDA Drug Labels** (filtering out homeopathic/cosmetic blends), **DailyMed SPL XML** LOINC fallback, **MedlinePlus Connect**, conditional **OpenFDA FAERS**, **NIH DSLD v9**, **NIH NCCIH**, **PubChem/LiverTox**, and pairwise/class-level **PubMed** verification.
2. **Clinical Quote Safety & Combined Decision-1 Gate (`POST /v1beta/decisions`):**
   - **Operator-Preserving Verbatim Check:** Preserves clinical operators and signs (`<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, `-`, `+`, `%`, `.`) so dosing/threshold flips (`eGFR < 30` vs `>= 30`) never falsely verify.
   - **Raw-Span Quote Recovery & Combined Gate:** Runs deterministic raw-span quote recovery on `claims[]`, gates both `claims[]` and `structured_items[]`, safely skips unattached PDFs (`skipped_unattached_pdf`), and drops non-PDF claims failing both quote recovery and Decision-1 entailment (`P_entailed < 0.70`).
3. **Lean Frontier Harness & Row-Aware Safety Capping:**
   - Unified `S1..Sn` source handles, concise premises-first `reconciliation_notes`, `on_failure_only` atomic Hop-2 default with `suggested_followup_axes`, calibrated `medium` UCS `thinking_level` (`high` in `EXHAUSTIVE`), randomized XML boundary nonces, full FDA/DailyMed/PMC auto-staging to `workspace/in/`, and **row-aware** output capping that never slices clinical quotes or FDA boxed warnings mid-sentence.

contextPrompt: Medical Mode Protocol (v2.0.0): Skip tools for settled basic anatomy or definitions. Use `drug_and_interaction_lookup` for Rx/OTC drugs, supplements, vitamins, herbals, dosing, safety, or interactions; use `medical_evidence_search` for disease guidelines, diagnostics, prognosis, pharmacokinetics, or clinical trials (split 3+ unrelated topics across parallel calls). Inspect `control_layer.evidence_status`, `anecdotal_signal_only`, `data_layer.claims[].quote_verified`, `decision_audit`, `missing_facets`, and `retrieval_state.suggested_followup_axes`. Distinguish FDA labels/guidelines vs peer-reviewed RCTs vs case reports/FAERS/preprints/commercial supplement labels. Never treat an isolated case report, animal/in-vitro study, or FAERS count as confirmed human clinical causality, and never treat missing label/PubMed text as proof of safety. Bind PMIDs, PMCIDs, NCT IDs, and URLs strictly from `cited_sources[]` attached to each claim; staged full labels/records live in `workspace/in/`. Maintain evidence-backed conclusions against user pushback or anecdotes. Use clear plain English without boilerplate legal disclaimers; calmly advise prompt in-person care for emergency red-flag symptoms.

userSettings.name: generative_model
userSettings.label: Generative Gemini Model ID
userSettings.description: Gemini model ID for clinical extraction and fallback routing (gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-4-carbon, gemini-4-neon, or gemini-4-argon).

userSettings.name: verification_engine
userSettings.label: Verification & Medical Evidence Scoring Engine
userSettings.description: Controls calibrated scoring: hybrid_auto uses Gemini Decision 1 (gemini-decision-1) for clinical source tiering, negative-control guarding, chunk reranking, and claim entailment gating.

userSettings.name: enable_hop2_verification
userSettings.label: Hop-2 Iterative Gap & Falsification Loop
userSettings.description: Controls internal Hop-2 verification: on_failure_only (default) runs Hop-2 only on heavy entailment rejection so Gemini 4 drives normal multi-hop follow-ups; auto/always_on_gaps trigger internally on tension or gaps.

userSettings.name: google_api_key
userSettings.label: Google Gemini API Key
userSettings.description: Google Gemini API key for Interactions API and Gemini Decision 1 (auto-falls back to GEMINI_API_KEY / GEMINI_PAID_API_KEY in Gemini Chat Hub).

userSettings.name: ncbi_api_key
userSettings.label: NCBI E-utilities API Key (Optional)
userSettings.description: Optional free NCBI API key to raise PubMed/PMC rate limits from 3 req/s to 10 req/s.

userSettings.name: openfda_api_key
userSettings.label: OpenFDA API Key (Optional)
userSettings.description: Optional free OpenFDA API key for higher label/FAERS request quotas.

userSettings.name: action_on_error
userSettings.label: Action on Tool Error
userSettings.description: Choose whether to return structured diagnostic JSON to the AI model or throw an immediate UI error.

openaiSpec.name: medical_evidence_search
openaiSpec.description: Searches curated public biomedical APIs ONLY (zero open web): NIH MedlinePlus, NCBI PubMed, PMC BioC full text, NIH NCCIH monographs, PubChem, Europe PMC, and ClinicalTrials.gov v2, with calibrated gemini-decision-1 verification and quote recovery. Pass optional pubmedQueries, trialCondition, trialIntervention, trialPhase, or supplements to steer retrieval directly (bypassing the internal router). For individual drug/supplement safety, dosing, or interactions, prefer `drug_and_interaction_lookup`. Examples: (1) {"query": "SGLT2 inhibitors eGFR cutoff chronic kidney disease guidelines", "pubmedQueries": ["SGLT2 inhibitor chronic kidney disease eGFR guideline"], "evidenceScope": "peer_reviewed_only"} (2) {"query": "psilocybin phase 3 major depressive disorder clinical trials", "evidenceScope": "clinical_trials", "trialCondition": "Major Depressive Disorder", "trialIntervention": "psilocybin", "trialPhase": "PHASE3"}

query.description: Focused biomedical objective (2-3 core concepts: condition, intervention, population, or PK/trial outcome).

evidenceScope.description: Scope selector: auto (default), patient_overview, peer_reviewed_only, or clinical_trials.

detailMode.description: Retrieval depth & output cap: AUTO (default), MINIMAL (skips router), or EXHAUSTIVE (broader + high thinking).

pubmedQueries.description: Optional 1-3 focused PubMed queries (max 2-3 concepts each) to steer PubMed directly and bypass the internal LLM router.

trialCondition.description: Optional normalized condition name for ClinicalTrials.gov query.cond.

trialIntervention.description: Optional normalized intervention/drug name for ClinicalTrials.gov query.intr.

supplements.description: Optional supplement/herbal/vitamin names to fetch NIH NCCIH & PubChem profiles directly.

documentUrl.description: Optional direct public http(s) URL to a medical PDF or HTML guideline (e.g., PMC open-access PDF) for native multimodal ingestion.

pluginFunctions.name: drug_and_interaction_lookup
pluginFunctions.label: Drug & Supplement Lookup

openaiSpec.name: drug_and_interaction_lookup
openaiSpec.description: Authoritative lookup for Rx drugs, OTC medications, dietary supplements, vitamins, amino acids, and herbals via RxNorm/RxClass, single-ingredient OpenFDA drug labels, DailyMed LOINC SPL XML, MedlinePlus Connect, NIH DSLD v9, NIH NCCIH, PubChem/LiverTox, conditional FAERS, and pairwise/class PubMed verification with gemini-decision-1 negative-control guarding and quote recovery. Examples: (1) {"drugs": ["sertraline", "ibuprofen"], "focus": "interactions", "patientContext": "older adult"} (2) {"drugs": ["metformin"], "focus": "contraindications", "patientContext": "chronic kidney disease eGFR < 30"}

drugs.description: 1 to 5 medication, OTC drug, vitamin, herbal, or dietary supplement names (brand or generic).

focus.description: Target clinical focus scoping FDA label sections and literature queries.

patientContext.description: Optional non-identifying clinical context (e.g., pregnancy, renal impairment eGFR < 30, OTC adult, supplement).

detailMode.description: Optional depth & output cap: AUTO (default), MINIMAL (12K cap), or EXHAUSTIVE (38K cap + high thinking).
